rawFindings.title: Incorrect param callback error handling allowing skipped re-calls when error is 'route'
rawFindings.explanation: The patch changes the condition that skips param callback re-calls from excluding only errors that are not 'route' to excluding any error. This means that if paramCalled.error is 'route', the callback will be skipped instead of called again. This breaks the expected behavior where next('route') allows param callbacks to run for different param values separately.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert line 361 to original condition: if (paramCalled && (paramCalled.match === paramVal || (paramCalled.error && paramCalled.error !== 'route'))) to ensure param callbacks are re-called when error is 'route'.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When a param callback calls next('route') which sets paramCalled.error to 'route', subsequent requests with different param values will not re-call the param callback, thus skipping parameter processing unexpectedly.
